subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this grouped set of privileged GitHub Action revisions on the current exact head?
rationale: These actions execute with credentials or security/release permissions, and the branch has repeatedly rebased; accepting the new upstream code requires owner judgment after exact-head verification.

options.title: Approve verified grouped bump
options.body: Approve the exact head after upstream contract review and all affected checks complete successfully.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate token, Codex, security-scanning, and release action bumps for narrower review and rollback.

options.title: Retain current pins
options.body: Pause the update if stable exact-head or upstream-contract verification cannot be obtained.

recommendation.title: Approve verified grouped bump
recommendation.body: Approve the exact head after upstream contract review and all affected checks complete successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows broad ownership of action modernization and Codex-agent workflows, and the PR timeline records direct engagement.
